items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: They had a wonderful drummer named Norm Landry. Norm is now still living and playing in Houston, Texas. And Pat and Bob were both there. Bob Canfield was there. But anyway, they had always wanted me to join them.

ctx.x: I didn't get what he played. Well, actually, this was just a little trio.

And, it was Jack and Terry Sheehan up in, uh, Thomas John, and William Gramsson, and all that stuff. And, they played all the society dances, and they played the Fiori roof garden. And, this particular man, this guy, who I was talking about, uh, was, uh, Asian. He hired them. And, uh, so I guess the buddies then, uh, who, uh, who, uh, were, uh, uh, who, uh, were included the Red Round Tree and Buddy Seeky and drums and, um, who included Red Roundtree and Buddy Seaton on drums and Shockey Wilcox on trumpet. And…
No, that's right. You didn't tell me much about New Orleans, you tripped down.
